plain: Get 1.5 points for every dollar you spend, 3 times the points when you eat out, 4 times the points on streaming services, plus 60,000 extra points once you spend $4,000 within your first 3 months.
alt: Rack up 1.5 points on every dollar, triple points at restaurants, quadruple points on streaming, and unlock a 60,000-point welcome bonus when you spend $4,000 in your first 3 months.
frame_flip: Don't miss out on 1.5 points per dollar, 3x points on dining, 4x on streaming, or the 60,000-point welcome bonus you'd forfeit without spending $4,000 in 3 months.
reordered: Spend $4,000 in 3 months to get a 60,000-point welcome bonus, plus 4x points on streaming, 3x on dining, and 1.5 points per dollar on everything else.
